text:
Type: square storage ottoman
Use: extra seat, footrest, hidden storage; living room, bedroom
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: printed fabric upholstery, brass nailhead trim, dark wood legs, hinged lid
Colors: warm cream, grey script print, brass, dark espresso
Shape: cube with lift-up padded lid, nailhead band at the base, four short tapered legs, compact
Feel: charming, vintage, cozy
Goes with: cream or beige walls, dark wood, brass accents; traditional or French country rooms

product.name: First Hill Elaina Square Fabric Storage Ottoman with Script-Style Pattern - Neutral Beige
product.description: Small square-shaped storage ottoman for use as a footrest and/or storage; ideal for a living room, study, or bedroom Padded lid hinges open for access to interior storage space—holds anything from books and games to extra throws Elegant script-style fabric upholstery in neutral brown and beige hues; antique-look nail-head trim along the base 4 block-style feet in an accenting dark color provide reliable strength and stability Measures 17.5 by 17.5 by 17.8 inches; minimal assembly required
